ABOUT WATCHPOST

A focused AI product.
A clearly defined buyer.

For security operators managing warehouses and commercial sites. Watchpost looks for events such as an open service gate or movement in a closed area, then gives the supervisor a timestamped review queue.

Illustrative operating context · licensed photography
THE BUSINESS IDEA

AI checks site video for defined events and sends supervisors the relevant clip.

Video is a continuous workload. The system checks frames for defined events, groups repeated detections and sends only the relevant time window for a supervisor to review.

Who buys it
Contract security operators & site supervisors
What they send in
Authorized camera streams and site event rules
What they receive
A timestamped event clip and reason for review
How it is sold
A B2B subscription with a defined processing allowance.
OWNERSHIP & PRODUCT STATUS

Clear about the
business behind the page.

Watchpost is an MVP product concept developed for Uniqkode. The website and review tools work; prepared case data demonstrates the intended AI workflow. A live model account and production identity service are not connected by default.

Customer endorsements, paid-user counts and company registration details have not been supplied. This website makes no claim that an unrelated company uses the product or that a registered legal entity operates it.
